summary: Fixed default-port removal in URL normalization while preserving non-default ports and other URL components.
rationale: The normalizer identified default ports but retained the port suffix when rebuilding the authority. It now omits that suffix only for HTTP port 80 and HTTPS port 443; the existing LinkService flow already saves the normalized destination.
content:
## Implementation

Corrected authority reconstruction so default ports are removed from saved destinations. Non-default ports, path, fragment, and non-UTM query parameters remain preserved.
